mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom remodel take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathroom remodel can take anywhere from a few weeks to a couple of months depending on scope, design complexity, and lead times for materials. A simple project may move faster, while a full gut remodel or one with custom finishes usually takes longer. Ask your contractor to separate design time, permit time, and construction time so you know where delays could happen.
